snippet.title: Antioma — Announcement Trailer | Steam
snippet.description:
Link to the Steam page and socials are in the first comment.

In this video, we showed the beginning of the story about Kiddo. On his 7th birthday Kiddo will finally leave the hospital, where he had spent almost his whole life. He will finally see the real world with all its wonders and horrors.

About the game:
Dive into a touching story. The little boy Kiddo has spent most of his life in hospital. Little does he know what a complicated and fascinating world lies concealed beyond the hospital walls. 
Today, on Kiddo's birthday, his mom wasn't around. Instead of her, the boy met Shadow, who inspired him to escape from a hospital and set out in search of his mom. 
Solve puzzles, hide and run from your enemies, make friends, and help the boy get home.
Real adventures lie in wait for Kiddo! Now his fate is in your hands…

#trailer #indiegame #adventure #pointnclick #indiedev
